selected_decision.next_check: October 31, 2026 closing, extension or termination disclosure, with guarantor, construction funding and any condition waivers identified. December 31 TTU notice is a separate checkpoint.

verified_facts.claim: Lee McIntire is Chief Executive Officer of Fermi Inc., which operates as Fermi America.

Fermi disclosed the signed TensorWave closing extension on September 22nd, 2026; the deadline changed from September 30th to October 31st, 2026. A separate amendment execution date is not established.
Fermi Campus 1 LLC is the landlord and TensorWave TEX1 LLC is the tenant. This is the first customer lease at Project Matador; TensorWave is an AI cloud provider.

The original closing deadline was subject to extension. Either party may terminate if conditions are not satisfied. Keeping the original deadline was an available contractual path, not evidence of an immediate termination decision.

The amendment leaves the remaining terms unchanged. Effectiveness requires satisfaction or waiver of closing conditions including work letters, guaranties, operations schedules, service-level agreement, board approvals and construction financing.
Project Matador is in the Texas Panhandle on Texas Tech University System ground-leased land in Carson County.

Fermi must receive a notice to proceed from TTU by December 31st, 2026 before vertical data-center construction; TTU may terminate if notice is not received. Conditions include a first tenant of at least 200 MW and first-phase financing.
The TensorWave lease covers 222 MW of total facility power after the final phase. That figure is contracted scope rather than current operating output.
American Buildout reported on October 3rd, 2026 that the lease had yet to close. No later closing or completed guaranty is established by the current-run reviewed disclosures.
The SEC filing targets delivery in phases from late 2027 into the first quarter of 2028.
The guarantor identity and completed project financing are not established by the reviewed disclosures. October 31 is a disclosure checkpoint; it does not guarantee closing or completed buildings.
